summaryLines: Renews monthly — your saved card is charged automatically each billing cycle until you cancel.

**12-hour** cancellation / reschedule policy; late cancellations and no-shows forfeit **one class credit**.
**3‑month minimum** commitment; fee may apply if you cancel early.

101.termsHtml:
Membership Agreement

By joining, you agree to a monthly membership that renews automatically. Your card on file will be charged on a recurring monthly basis until canceled.

This membership includes 5 classes per month and renews every month on your billing date.

Classes are valid only within each billing cycle. Any unused classes at the end of the month will not roll over and will be forfeited.

To keep the flow and experience smooth for everyone, we kindly ask that all classes be canceled at least 12 hours in advance. Late cancellations or no-shows will result in the loss of one class from your monthly allowance.

This membership includes a minimum commitment of 3 months. After the initial 3-month period, you’re welcome to cancel anytime by notifying us before your next billing date.

If you choose to cancel before completing the 3-month commitment, an early cancellation fee equal to 50% of one month’s membership will apply.

Memberships are non-transferable, non-refundable, and intended for personal use only. All sales are final.

We’re so happy to have you as part of the AMARÉ community.

102.termsHtml:
Membership Agreement

By joining, you agree to monthly membership charged automatically each billing cycle.

This plan includes 8 classes per month. Unused classes expire at cycle end.

Cancel/reschedule sessions at least 12 hours in advance — late cancellations and no‑shows deduct one scheduled class credit.

3‑month commitment applies; cancellations after commitment may proceed with notice before renewal; cancellation before fulfilling the commitment may incur an early‑termination fee (see Mindbody Checkout or desk for specifics).

Programs are non‑transferable, non-refundable, sales final unless required by law.

summaryLines: **Unlimited** eligible classes per billing month (schedule & capacity permitting).

100.termsHtml:
Unlimited Monthly Membership

Enjoy unlimited qualifying classes subject to scheduling, attendance policies, and Amare Wellness rules communicated at booking.

Membership bills monthly until canceled in writing before the next renewal, following your commitment period.

Honor the 12-hour cancellation guideline so spacing stays fair for everyone; repeated late cancels/no-shows may result in forfeits or suspension per studio policy.

Unlimited memberships remain non-transferable and non-refundable. Changes in Mindbody should be echoed here when updated.
